name: Expenses Report
query:
SELECT 
    exp.date as Date, 
    exp.expense_type as "Expense Type",
    exp.remark as "Comment:Data:300",
    exp.paid_from as "Paid From:Data:150",
    exp.amount as "Amount:Currency",
    ""
FROM `tabExpenses` exp
JOIN `tabJournal Entry` je ON je.name = exp.journal_entry
WHERE exp.date BETWEEN %(from)s AND %(to)s
    AND exp.docstatus = 1
    AND je.docstatus = 1
